Toothpaste, Oral Care Products & Dental Health


Help keep sugar acids and plaque at bay by brushing twice-daily with Aquafresh toothpaste, with *protection provided by fluoride. From kids’ toothpaste for milk teeth to oral care products for mighty adult teeth, Aquafresh helps to protect the whole family against decay and cavities. So you can always show your best smile.

Our Triple Protection Promise

Fresh breath

Aquafresh has a range of minty, whitening toothpastes and great flavours that all aim to give you a truly fresh feeling.

Strong teeth

Active fluoride in our toothpastes strengthens tooth enamel and helps protect against sugar acid attacks, giving you even more reasons to smile.

Healthy gums

All our toothpastes help remove plaque with twice-daily brushing, helping to keep your gums happy and healthy.
